title: SoulPass
tagline: token gated community on telegram, using soul bond token standard
description: This project is a decentralized application (DApp) that allows users to sign a transaction using a Ledger device, check if they hold a Soulbound Token (SBT), and gain access to a token-gated community (Telegram group). If the user does not hold the required SBT, they can mint an NFT directly from the application to gain access.
